summary.T0044: Static analysis of T0042's chess-emitted .lst files extracted PC-byte boundaries of all loops in kernel_av (4 loops) and kernel_qk_softmax (12 loops). Main MAC loop in kernel_av (offset _784) has 352 PC bytes ≈ 44 cycles per iteration at conservative 8 bytes/cycle. NTOK=256 outer × NUM_TILES=256 inner gives an estimate range: optimistic (II=2 pipeline) 115 us, conservative (no pipeline) 2307 us. T0042 analytic central 160 us falls within range, validating T0042's II~2 assumption. Limitation: PC bytes ≠ cycles for VLIW; without -fchess-schedule-dump annotations OR runtime profile, the steady-state II cannot be derived exactly.
summary.T0045: Task spec premise was wrong. aiecompiler 2024.1 does NOT have a --target=hw_emu option (only --target=x86sim or --target=hw). 'hw_emu' is a v++ target, not aiecompiler. Verified with `aiecompiler --help` showing only the two real targets. Alternative paths (standalone aiesim hw + PLIO-only graph rewrite) both have their own blockers documented in result.json.
